The two differ only at about the 1e-12 relative level (JAX non-determinism), but a reader diffing the fragment against the log it names finds a mismatch.

the brief's own line 'Your done-when names no artifact, so this node writes no figure and no evidence prose' was not reconciled with delivery: the node wrote both a prose fragment and a PNG/SVG figure.
